Reynolds.ko: 관성력 대 점성력의 비. 층류·난류 천이를 결정하는 기본 무차원수.
Reynolds.en: Ratio of inertial to viscous forces. Determines laminar–turbulent transition.

CFL.ko: Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy 조건. 명시적 시간 적분의 안정성을 결정. C = uΔt/Δx ≤ C_max.
CFL.en: Courant–Friedrichs–Lewy condition. Stability bound for explicit time integration.

Mach.ko: 유속/음속 비. 압축성·충격파 발생 여부 판단.
Mach.en: Flow speed divided by sound speed. Indicates compressibility and shock formation.

Riemann.ko: 두 상태 사이의 초기 불연속을 풀어내는 1-D 문제. CFD 수치 플럭스의 기반.
Riemann.en: 1-D initial discontinuity problem between two states. Foundation of numerical fluxes in CFD.

HLLC.ko: Harten–Lax–van Leer Contact. 접촉 불연속을 처리하는 근사 Riemann solver.
HLLC.en: Harten–Lax–van Leer Contact. Approximate Riemann solver that captures contact discontinuities.

RANS.ko: Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes. 시간평균을 통해 난류를 모델링한 형태.
RANS.en: Reynolds-Averaged Navier–Stokes. Time-averaged form for turbulence modeling.

LES.ko: Large Eddy Simulation. 큰 와류는 직접 풀고 작은 와류는 모델링.
LES.en: Large Eddy Simulation. Resolves large vortices, models sub-grid scales.

DNS.ko: Direct Numerical Simulation. 모든 난류 스케일을 직접 해상.
DNS.en: Direct Numerical Simulation. Resolves all turbulence scales directly.

Kolmogorov.ko: 에너지 캐스케이드의 가장 작은 스케일. η = (ν³/ε)^(1/4).
Kolmogorov.en: Smallest scale in the turbulence energy cascade. η = (ν³/ε)^(1/4).

VOF.ko: Volume of Fluid. 다상유동에서 각 상의 부피분율을 추적.
VOF.en: Volume of Fluid. Tracks volume fractions of each phase in multiphase flow.

EOS.ko: Equation of State. p = f(ρ, e) 형태의 상태방정식.
EOS.en: Equation of State. Closure relation p = f(ρ, e).

OpenFOAM.en: Open-source CFD library based on finite volume method.

WENO.ko: Weighted Essentially Non-Oscillatory. 충격파 근처에서 비진동 고차 재구성.
WENO.en: Weighted Essentially Non-Oscillatory. High-order non-oscillatory reconstruction near shocks.

TVD.ko: Total Variation Diminishing. 비물리적 진동을 막는 단조성 조건.
TVD.en: Total Variation Diminishing. Monotonicity condition preventing spurious oscillations.

SIMPLE.ko: Semi-Implicit Method for Pressure-Linked Equations. 비압축성 압력-속도 결합 알고리즘.
SIMPLE.en: Semi-Implicit Method for Pressure-Linked Equations. Incompressible pressure–velocity coupling.

PISO.ko: Pressure Implicit with Splitting of Operators. SIMPLE 변형, 비정상 해석에 효율적.
PISO.en: Pressure Implicit with Splitting of Operators. Efficient for transient flows.
